Não somos apenas engenheiros. Somos uma equipe global de cientistas de dados, consultores, trabalhadores da construção e inovadores, todos trabalhando para criar um amanhã melhor. Todos os dias, ajudamos os clientes de energia, produtos químicos e recursos a se aproximarem mais da solução dos problemas mais difíceis do planeta. Das Alterações Climáticas. A transição energética. Transformação digital. E como podemos entregar para um mundo mais sustentável.

Seja qual for a sua ambição, há um caminho para você aqui. E não há barreira para o sucesso potencial de sua carreira. Para obter mais informações, visite Worley.com

Estamos buscando para um de nossos projetos um Especialista de Qualidade para atuar presencialmente em um de nossos projetos no escritório do Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Propósito Geral do Papel

Oferece suporte nos Projetos designados para garantir que o projeto seja executado de acordo com os requisitos de qualidade do BMP e Petrobrás. Interage regularmente com representantes de diversos grupos funcionais, incluindo Gerentes de Projetos e time de engenharia do projeto.

Informações Técnicas Adicionais

Desejável conhecimento da ISO 9001. Nivel de inglês que possa promover autonomia na leitura de procedimentos e implantação.

Detalhes em Nível Global

Resumo

O Especialista de Qualidade será responsável pelo follow-up dos cronogramas de qualidade (Project Quality Schedule), garantindo o cumprimento dos marcos, entregáveis e requisitos mandatórios, bem como pelo monitoramento da aderência aos planos de qualidade, indicadores e auditorias internas e externas.

Adicionalmente, será responsável por garantir a aplicação consistente e rigorosa dos processos, procedimentos e requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade da Worley, atuando de forma proativa na identificação, análise e resolução de problemas de qualidade no dia a dia dos projetos e operações.

Este profissional deverá conduzir propor e acompanhar a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas, assegurando a eliminação das causas dos desvios e a melhoria contínua dos processos. Espera-se atuação próxima às equipes multidisciplinares, com postura consultiva, senso crítico e forte orientação para resultados.

O papel exige rigoroso atendimento aos processos Worley, alto nível de organização, autonomia, capacidade analítica e comunicação eficaz, incluindo a condução de fóruns de lições aprendidas, para suportar decisões.

Qualificações

Diploma universitário, em área relacionada a Qualidade e experiência relevante equivalente. Sólida experiência relevante.

Tomada de Decisão

Atuando sob supervisão mínima, com capacidade de planejar e gerenciar o próprio trabalho, executar tarefas variadas e complexas, identificar problemas e recomendar soluções de forma eficaz.

Reporta-se à

Atua sob supervisão geral e orientação técnica quando necessário, com interação semanal a mensal. O trabalho não é normalmente supervisionado em detalhe, e o nível de acompanhamento varia de acordo com a complexidade da tarefa. As atividades são atribuídas de forma ampla, geralmente em ciclos mensais, e o trabalho é ocasionalmente revisado quanto à precisão. Há suporte técnico disponível para revisão das entregas e orientação em casos de situações ou requisitos não usuais.

Autoridade de Supervisão

Pode atribuir atividades e fornecer orientação técnica às equipes de engenharia no que se refere aos processos de Qualidade da Worley.

Comunicação

Comunica ideias e conceitos de forma clara e eficaz, conduzindo fóruns de lições aprendidas tanto internamente quanto com o cliente.

Sistemas, Processos e Ferramentas

Sólida compreensão dos sistemas de Qualidade, processos e ferramentas da área, com habilidade para apoiar colegas e resolver problemas de forma eficaz.

Localidade

Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Se você tem paixão e talento para se manter atualizado, é hora de testar os limites do que você pode se tornar. Encontre seu futuro na Worley.

title: Associate Programmatic Manager
description:
Buy Box Experts (BBE) is a Spreetail Agency, our mission at BBE is to be premier Amazon strategists by successfully evolving and adapting to the ever‑changing environment that is Amazon and e‑commerce. Our strategic growth mindset and holistic approach encourage forward‑thinking and provide the greatest potential for success for our Brand Partners.

We’re looking for a results‑driven Associate Programmatic Manager to lead the launch, management, and optimization of cross‑channel campaigns across programmatic, Meta, and Google platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced environment, has a sharp analytical mindset, and can balance creative strategy with performance‑driven execution to maximize visibility, audience reach, and revenue growth.

How you will achieve success in this role:

  • Launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Programmatic, Meta, Google Ads/YouTube, and other digital placements.
  • Develop and implement data‑driven media strategies to drive visibility, incremental reach, and customer acquisition.
  • Collaborate with Merchandising, Brand Strategy, and PPC teams to align campaigns with business and brand goals.
  • Monitor budgets, pacing, and performance to achieve ROI and efficiency targets.
  • Deliver weekly performance analysis with actionable insights and recommendations.

What experiences will help you in this role:

  • 4–6 years of hands‑on experience managing programmatic, Meta, and Google ad campaigns.
  • Proven success in driving incremental reach and revenue growth with large‑scale media budgets ($6M+ annually).
  • Expertise with Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, DV360, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Ads/YouTube.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with visualization tools a plus.
  • Ability to collaborate cross‑functionally and thrive in a fast‑paced, performance‑driven environment.

We consider candidates who meet the specific job qualifications, whether they are located near our Lehi, UT office or have the ability to work remotely.

Please visit comparably.com/companies/buy-box-experts to learn more about us.

ABOUT BUY BOX EXPERTS

Buy Box Experts, a Spreetail Agency, is a premier Amazon marketing agency, supporting brand executives as they seek to CONTROL and GROW their Amazon channel businesses (in the US and internationally).

We help our brand clients develop channel management strategies that reduce price erosion issues, and align marketing efforts with the brand's overall brand vision. We provide full platform account management (1P retail, 3P marketplace and hybrid) incorporating inventory management, listing optimization, advertising campaign management (including AMS, DSP), and customer service. We also operate traffic‑building campaigns external to Amazon, designed to drive high‑converting traffic to Amazon. We conduct Amazon channel due diligence for private equity and investors looking to acquire brands that depend heavily on Amazon as a sales channel.

Our leadership team is very focused on building a company culture focused on being inclusive, encouraging open discussion of issues, and developing the team through a growth‑based mindset. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

A Coordenação de Inteligência e Governança em Compras é responsável por estruturar, sustentar e evoluir a forma como Compras mede desempenho, garante compliance, organiza dados e melhora processos, atuando como o “centro de excelência” da área. A equipe conecta estratégia, processos, sistemas, dados e controles para apoiar decisões mais rápidas, seguras e orientadas a resultado.

Descrição do cargo

Buscamos profissional para atuar como analista de dados e governança para a área de Compras, garantindo:

  • Qualidade e confiabilidade das informações de compras (SLA, spend, fornecedores, contratos e performance)
  • Indicadores e painéis para gestão e tomada de decisão
  • Governança nas contratações - previsibilidade das demandas junto às áreas de negócio
  • Apoio a iniciativas de transformação digital, com foco em S2P, automação de processos de compra orientada por dados e IA, melhoria da jornada do usuário e eficiência operacional

Responsabilidades:

  • Construir, manter e evoluir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (KPIs de compras, produtividade, SLA, savings, ciclo de compra, compliance, spend por categoria/fornecedor etc.)
  • Executar análises de spend (classificação, concentração, tendências, oportunidades, riscos e anomalias)
  • Tratar e consolidar bases (ERP/SAP, portal de compras, planilhas, bases de fornecedores), garantindo integridade e rastreabilidade
  • Apoiar análises para previsibilidade de OPEX e CAPEX (previsto x realizado, tendências, variações, projeções e premissas)
  • Apoiar a coordenação na padronização de processos e na documentação (fluxos, políticas, checklists, SLAs)
  • Contribuir com as rotinas de governança nas contratações (base de contratos, vencimentos de contratos, alertas, demandas em andamento, consolidação e visibilidade)
  • Preparar materiais executivos para comitês e liderança

Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou Engenharia.

Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Excel avançado (Power Query/Power Pivot, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, modelagem simples)

title: Analista de Remuneração SR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar como referência técnica em Remuneração na Log-In, liderando análises, modelos e projetos de remuneração fixa e variável, suportando decisões estratégicas da Diretoria e de Gente & Gestão. Garantir estruturas salariais competitivas, políticas claras e sustentáveis, equilíbrio interno/externo e aderência a orçamento, contribuindo para atração, retenção e engajamento dos talentos da Companhia, em alinhamento à estratégia do negócio, valores corporativos e Sistema de Gestão Integrada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A SUA ROTINA INCLUI:

1. Estrutura de Cargos e Salários

Atuar como guardião da política de cargos e salários, apoiando revisões, melhorias e desdobramentos junto às áreas de negócio.

Conduzir análises de equilíbrio interno (faixas, sobreposições, compressão salarial, enquadramentos) e propor ajustes em estruturas, níveis e grades.

Apoiar e/ou liderar processos de descrição, avaliação e classificação de cargos, utilizando metodologias corporativas (pontos, fatores, famílias, trilhas de carreira etc.).

Atualizar e manter tabelas salariais, referências, amplitudes e ranges por unidade de negócio, nível e função, garantindo coerência com a estrutura organizacional.

2. Pesquisas de Mercado e Competitividade Externa

Coordenar a participação da Log-In em pesquisas salariais de mercado (empresas de consultoria, sindicatos e entidades setoriais), garantindo qualidade das informações enviadas.

Analisar resultados de pesquisas (ex.: P50, P25, P75) e elaborar estudos comparativos de competitividade por cargo, família, unidade de negócio e região.

Elaborar recomendações técnicas de posicionamento salarial, ajustes de faixa, política para novos cargos e estratégias para funções críticas e de difícil reposição.

3. Ciclos de Mérito, Ajustes Gerais e Recomposição

Planejar, modelar e simular cenários de mérito, promoções, ajustes de faixas e recomposição por Acordo Coletivo, considerando budget, diretrizes de Diretoria e impacto em folha.

Desenvolver ferramentas (planilhas, modelos, painéis) que suportem alocação de verba de mérito pelas lideranças, garantindo simplicidade e governança.

Apoiar Gente & Gestão e a Diretoria na definição de diretrizes anuais (critérios de elegibilidade, limites, prazos e mensagens-chave) para os ciclos de revisão salarial.

Acompanhar a execução dos processos no sistema (ERP, HCM etc.), tratando exceções, conferindo resultados e assegurando integridade de dados.

4. Programas de Remuneração Variável e Incentivos

Apoiar a modelagem, revisão e governança de programas de remuneração variável (bônus/PLR, incentivos de curto prazo, comissões, gratificações), alinhados à estratégia e resultados do negócio.

Desenvolver e analisar indicadores, metas e pesos dos programas de incentivo em parceria com Finanças, áreas de negócio e Gente & Gestão.

Elaborar simulações de cenários de pagamento, impacto financeiro e comparativos históricos, apoiando decisões da Diretoria e do Conselho, quando aplicável.

5. Análises, Estudos Especiais e Governança

Produzir dashboards, relatórios e análises de remuneração (pay mix, pay gap, estrutura por nível, dispersão, headcount e payroll) para Diretoria, Comitês e Conselhos, quando demandado.

Apoiar estudos de reorganização organizacional (fusões de áreas, criação/extinção de cargos, movimentações em massa), avaliando impactos em remuneração e propondo soluções técnicas.

Atuar como referência para consultas complexas de remuneração das áreas (pacotes de contratação, retenção, realocação, casos críticos e exceções), garantindo aderência às políticas e governança.

Apoiar iniciativas relacionadas à equidade interna, diversidade e inclusão do ponto de vista de remuneração (estudos de pay equity, recortes por gênero, raça, unidade etc.).

6. Processos, Sistemas e Melhoria Contínua

Propor e liderar melhorias em processos, políticas, ferramentas e sistemas de remuneração, buscando mais automação, segurança e padronização.

Atuar em conjunto com TI, Finanças e Gente & Gestão na evolução de sistemas de folha, HCM, analytics e workflow relacionados a cargos, salários e incentivos.

Contribuir para a documentação e atualização de normas, políticas, manuais e comunicados de remuneração, garantindo entendimento por parte de líderes e colaboradores.

Conhecer a política, objetivos e metas do Sistema de Gestão Integrada.

Cumprir os procedimentos aplicáveis à atividade desenvolvida e os programas de qualidade, meio ambiente, saúde e segurança implementados na Companhia.

Conhecer os aspectos e impactos significativos associados às práticas de remuneração e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dentro do seu escopo.

description:
A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. title: Mineral Strategy Analyst - Aramco Transition Minerals -  (Based in Saudi Arabia - expat relocat[...]
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent, expat position.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Transition Minerals Strategy Analyst to join Aramco Transition Minerals organization to lead our efforts in securing, managing, and optimizing the sustainable use of transition minerals critical to the global energy transition. These minerals, such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, are essential for renewable energy technologies, and other clean energy solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in strategic planning, supply chain management, ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles, and policy advocacy. This role will also involve collaboration across industries, governments, and communities to address challenges and opportunities in the evolving transition minerals landscape.

About Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM)

Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM) is a new strategic initiative within Saudi Aramco’s Upstream division, created to advance the exploration, extraction, and processing of key energy transition minerals—including lithium—to support the global shift toward sustainable energy solutions and contribute to the Kingdom’s economic diversification goals.

Anchored in the ambitions of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, ATM is positioned to help establish the Kingdom as a leading global hub for critical minerals. The organization focuses on high‑value resources such as lithium, silicon, copper, nickel, graphite, and rare earth elements—materials essential to technologies like electric vehicles, renewable energy storage systems, and solar power generation.

As a newly formed and rapidly growing entity, ATM represents a significant opportunity to shape an emerging sector, drive technological innovation, and support the development of a resilient, future‑focused minerals supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Lead the development of a comprehensive, long-term strategy for sourcing and utilizing transition minerals. This strategy should align with our organizational goals in sustainability, innovation, and growth.
  • Monitor and interpret global trends, including technological advancements, regulatory changes, and market dynamics, to identify opportunities and risks for the organization.
  • Establish a roadmap for securing critical mineral resources while prioritizing long‑term sustainability and resilience.
  • Provide insights and recommendations on mineral financing strategies, investment opportunities, and risk management.
  • Collaborate with procurement and legal teams to establish long‑term agreements with suppliers who meet sustainability criteria.
  • Act as a liaison between the company and key external stakeholders, including government agencies, potential investors and industry groups
  • Represent the company at international conferences, working groups, and forums focused on transition minerals, ensuring our leadership and reputation in the industry.
  • Develop and review financial models, feasibility studies, and cost‑benefit analyses for mining and mineral projects.
  • Lead or support the evaluation, negotiation, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and industry best practices
  • Develop mitigation strategies to address risks such as resource scarcity, geopolitical tensions, and supply disruptions.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and trends that could redefine the transition minerals landscape.
  • Track and report on global mineral production, consumption patterns, and pricing trends to inform decision‑making.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze industry data, reports, and market trends to provide actionable insights to the leadership team.
  • Develop comprehensive reports and presentations for executive leadership, detailing progress, risks, and recommendations.

As a successful candidate you hold a:

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Mining Geology, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in energy transition minerals (lithium, cobalt, nickel, or rare earth elements) development with a focus in strategy.
  • The ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, to communicate effectively and clearly with specialists in other cross‑functional teams, and has excellent problem‑solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Expertise in critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, including their applications, extraction methods, and market dynamics
  • Strong understanding of mineralogy and metallurgical principles for transition minerals.
  • Knowledge of circular economy principles and recycling of transition minerals.
  • The ability to develop the business case strategically.
  • The ability to relocate to Saudi Arabia on a full‑time basis.
  • Advanced English proficiency. CV's must be submitted in English.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament’s international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast‑paced, and multicultural environment.

Key responsibilities

1, Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of major tournament‑related events, including but not limited to:

  • Oficial Dinner

  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick‑Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches

  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA’s global positioning.

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.
  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.

  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.
  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

4. Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.
  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.
  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

5. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.
  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.
  • Manage protocol requirements and high‑profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

  • Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, no. of hours/week can be negotiated during the initial interview, with possibility of transitioning to full time
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3-statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation-ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model-Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double-check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn-outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self-check work before submission.

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Second Interview + possibly a test assignment

  3. Final Interview

4. Offer and onboarding

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is hiring a Creator Manager to lead client-facing creator strategy and execution across our Creator Services division. This role owns the relationship between brands and our creator network - ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and performance-driven across platforms, including TikTok Shop, Amazon affiliate, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging commerce channels.

As a Creator Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for both clients and creators. You will shape activation strategy, oversee execution, and ensure creator output drives measurable impact while maintaining a strong creator experience. If you thrive at the intersection of relationships, strategy, and commerce - this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Strategy & Client Leadership: Lead creator and influencer strategy across client accounts, serving as the primary client-facing point of contact - presenting strategy, performance insights, and optimization recommendations.
  • Campaign Execution: Own end-to-end execution of creator campaigns, including sourcing, vetting, contracting, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Platform Activation: Activate creators across TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, paid UGC, Amazon, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
  • Commerce & Creative Alignment: Partner with the Account team and Content Studio to align creator efforts to hero SKUs, commission strategy, and creative frameworks.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track campaign performance and proactively recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Network & Operations: Manage usage rights, timelines, deliverables, CRM systems, and Darkroom's creator network infrastructure.
  • Team Development: Mentor junior team members and help scale best practices within Creator Services.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, or affiliate programs.
  • Strong client management experience and comfort leading strategy conversations.
  • Deep understanding of creator workflows, usage rights, and cross-platform activation.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop and affiliate models preferred; exposure to Amazon affiliate, LTK, or YouTube Shopping is a plus.
  • Analytical and performance-oriented, with the ability to translate creator output into measurable impact.
  • Highly organized and confident managing multiple clients and creator pipelines simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with a creator-first mindset and commercial awareness.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in-office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Job Description

Tietoevry Create is inviting a talented Data Engineer to join our growing team and support our customer BICS , a global telecommunication enabler with a physical network spanning the globe. In this role, you will work on the BICS Voice and CC Value Streams, delivering qualified customer and network support by designing, building, and optimizing large-scale data pipelines within the telecom domain. The position requires strong expertise in Scala Spark , Databricks , and AWS cloud services , and focuses on developing high-performance data platforms that enable network analytics, customer insights, real-time monitoring, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch data pipelines using Scala, Databricks Spark, Databricks SQL and Airflow
  • Implement optimized ETL/ELT processes to ingest, cleanse, transform, and enrich large volumes of telecom network, usage, and operational data
  • Ensure pipeline reliability, observability, and performance tuning of Spark workloads
  • Build and manage data architectures leveraging AWS services (such as but not limited to) S3, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code using Terraform
  • Ensure security best practices and compliance with telecom regulatory requirements (GDPR, Data sovereignty, retention)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Architecture, DevOps, Network Engineering, Business Intelligence)
  • Document system designs, data flows, and best practices

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Big Data Developer
  • Strong proficiency in Scala and functional programming concepts
  • Advanced experience with Apache Spark (batch processing using Data Frame API and low-level Spark API's, performance tuning, cluster optimization)
  • Experience with optimized SQL-based data transformations for analytics and machine learning workloads
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks including notebooks, jobs, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow (nice to have)
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD practices with Git, Jenkins/Gitlab Actions
  • Strong AWS skills: S3, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, and related services
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, data governance, and security best practices
  • Experience with Airflow integration with AWS services for end-to-end orchestration across cloud data pipelines

description:
Job Description


As a Product Owner, you are the link between vision and execution. You translate the product strategy into concrete development items and ensure delivery together with cross-module teams. Working closely with Product Management, other Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders, you break down the roadmap into actionable work, maintain the team backlog, and represent customer and market needs. With your understanding of Product Management principles and a co-innovation mindset, you enable us to continuously improve and deliver impactful, high-quality solutions.
Beyond internal alignment, you also engage directly with customers to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive co-innovation lead by the Product Manager.

Your Mission

  • Curate, prioritize, and maintain the team backlog, ensuring items are ready for planning and aligned with product strategy.

  • Define and uphold the Definition of Ready and Definition of Done with the team.
  • Ensuring delivery of PI Objectives and identifying risks and dependencies.
  • Accept or reject completed backlog items based on acceptance criteria and DoD.
  • Monitor and report on team KPIs, ensuring transparency via backlogs, boards, and metrics.
  • Ensure built-in quality, testability, and automation readiness across backlog items.
  • Work with other Product Owners and Architects to manage interfaces, dependencies, and integration needs.
  • Strive for continuous improvement in processes, practices, and product outcomes.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner in an agile software development environment in the context of Data, Reporting and AI.
  • Strong ability to translate product roadmaps into concrete backlog items and actionable requirements.
  • Familiarity with agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) and backlog management practices.
  • Solid understanding of Product Management and passion for co-innovation with customers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—able to clarify intent, align priorities, and engage customers.
  • Analytical, structured, and value-driven mindset with the ability to balance competing priorities.
  • Fluency in English

What We Offer

  • Direct influence on the success of our product roadmap in a fast-growing, innovative environment.
  • Continuous learning opportunities, mentorship, and personal ownership of key domain areas.
  • A modern, flexible working setup and a culture that values transparency, co-creation, and experimentation.
  • Close collaboration with Product Management, technology leadership, and customer stakeholders.

Required domain knowledge

  • Experience with live/near-real-time reporting , dashboarding, and analytical data models, including best practices for handling high-frequency operational data.
  • Knowledge of modern data and AI platform architectures (e.g., event-driven data pipelines, message-based integrations, hybrid transactional/analytical patterns).
  • Knowledge of data governance principles is a plus—data quality, lineage, access control, and metadata—especially in regulated contexts.
  • Familiarity with Power BI , SQL Server (SSIS and SSAS)
  • Experiences with data platform transformations (more modular with a clear product definition, Business Value driven)
  • Ability to translate reporting, analytics, and AI use cases (e.g., performance insights, anomaly detection, process optimization) into concrete product requirements .
  • Experience with Azure and AI tool stack (OpenAI / Azure AI Services) or similar tools, including model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, vectorization/embeddings, and responsible AI practices.
  • Practical experience in delivering real data or AI products into production , not only prototypes or dashboards
  • Understanding of MES data structures is a plus (event flows, and how operational data is generated, transformed, and consumed across modules)
  • Understanding how operational data is generated, its limitations, and how variability in manufacturing processes affects reporting and analytics.
  • Understanding of Paper/Board business is a plus

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
F&B Concessions Coordinator

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision-making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow-up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre-tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large-scale international events, preferably in the sports industry
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow-up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a service-focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre-tournament and operational tournament time)

title: ServiceNow Configuration Manager - Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
Configuration manager - ServiceNow

Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented ServiceNow Configuration Manager to take ownership of our Configuration Management process and ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of our ServiceNow CMDB. In this key role, you will help strengthen the foundation of our ITSM processes by maintaining auditable configuration data that drives stable operations and informed decision‑making across the organization.

Joining Tieto Indtech, Nexus unit as a ServiceNow Configuration manager

As a Configuration Manager , you will be responsible for leading the governance, data quality, and ongoing development of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will collaborate closely with Process Owners, Product Management, Customer Service functions, and the ServiceNow Platform Owner to ensure that configuration data remains trustworthy, complete, and aligned with our platform strategy and ITSM practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about structure, accuracy, and continuous improvement — and who enjoys influencing how the organization manages technology information at scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Configuration Management process and ensure the health and quality of CMDB data.
  • Define, develop, and maintain CMDB governance policies, including CI class models, naming conventions, and lifecycle states.
  • Maintain and enhance the CMDB data model, structure, and CI relationships.
  • Ensure configuration data is accurate, complete, compliant, and supports ITSM processes.
  • Collaborate with Incident, Change, Problem, and other Process Owners to ensure correct usage of CI data.
  • Support stakeholders across the organization in product management and customer onboarding activities.
  • Lead CMDB audits and health checks, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions.
  • Define requirements for discovery, integrations, and data population into the CMDB.
  • Serve as the functional lead for CMDB-related tools and integrations in partnership with the ServiceNow Platform Owner.
  • Align configuration management practices with the overall ServiceNow platform strategy, architecture, and roadmap.

To rock this position, you own

  • Strong hands‑on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and configuration management practices.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB structure, CI relationships, lifecycle management , and data modelling.
  • Experience with running ITSM processes in ServiceNow.
  • Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and a drive for data quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly across different teams.

Nice to have:

  • ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CMDB, Discovery, ITOM).
  • Experience of ServiceNow integrations, and data ingestion methods.
  • Experience supporting product onboarding or customer onboarding service processes in ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance activities related to configuration data.

What’s in it for you?

  • A role with significant ownership and impact on our ITSM and platform strategy.
  • A collaborative environment partnering with skilled professionals across IT and business.
  • Opportunities for growth within the ServiceNow and ITOM ecosystem.
  • A chance to shape how the organization manages essential configuration and service data.
  • We offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where you can grow your skills and advance your career. We are committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.
  • We offer you professional growth, open culture and an outstanding work‑life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

We offer:

  • The contract is for an indefinite period of time. We count on you!
  • Work partially or completely remote. Work from wherever it suits you.
  • Extra holidays. We have 25 days off plus 2 sick days.
  • We contribute from 10 400 CZK per year. You name it. Choose from contributions for pension and life insurance, sports, culture, health, travel or education in the cafeteria.
  • Educate yourself. We regularly organise and pay for IT courses, certifications, language training and personal development courses.
  • 123CZK meal allowance on top of your salary.
  • Reward for a new colleague. Refer another colleague to us and get up to 80,000 CZK.
  • We’ll support you when you’re sick. For colleagues who are seriously ill for a long period of time, we contribute to sick pay in excess of the law.
  • Extra work is appreciated. When overtime is needed, we pay more than the law requires.
  • Stay fit and fresh. In Ostrava, use the free fitness facilities in the building, in other locations, do sports with Multisport.
  • Nordic culture. At Tieto, we believe in you. No one is breathing down your neck and checking every minute of your work. We are friendly and open.

About Industry Nexus

Nexus supports its customers in business process automation by exchanging and sharing business information with their business partners. We have two service areas: Business Information eXchange (BIX) and Multichannel.

Nexus has a large existing customer base in the Nordics and is a growing business unit within Tietoevry Industry. With a unique combination of global capabilities and local presence, Nexus currently serves more than 4000 customers in 50+ countries around the world - creating a digital advantage for millions every day.

Join us and make your mark!

We look forward to your application!
Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Heli Huuhtanen, Head of Customer Experience Hub, via e-mail

About Tieto

Tieto creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, we work with our customers to develop digital futures where businesses, societies, and humanity thrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public‑sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tieto’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Bør.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion (tietoevry.com)

description:
Job Description

Tietoevry Create is inviting a talented Data Engineer to join our growing team and support our customer BICS , a global telecommunication enabler with a physical network spanning the globe. In this role, you will work on the BICS Voice and CC Value Streams, delivering qualified customer and network support by designing, building, and optimizing large-scale data pipelines within the telecom domain. The position requires strong expertise in Scala Spark , Databricks , and AWS cloud services , and focuses on developing high-performance data platforms that enable network analytics, customer insights, real-time monitoring, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch data pipelines using Scala, Databricks Spark, Databricks SQL and Airflow
  • Implement optimized ETL/ELT processes to ingest, cleanse, transform, and enrich large volumes of telecom network, usage, and operational data
  • Ensure pipeline reliability, observability, and performance tuning of Spark workloads
  • Build and manage data architectures leveraging AWS services (such as but not limited to) S3, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code using Terraform
  • Ensure security best practices and compliance with telecom regulatory requirements (GDPR, Data sovereignty, retention)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Architecture, DevOps, Network Engineering, Business Intelligence)
  • Document system designs, data flows, and best practices

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Big Data Developer
  • Strong proficiency in Scala and functional programming concepts
  • Advanced experience with Apache Spark (batch processing using Data Frame API and low-level Spark API's, performance tuning, cluster optimization)
  • Experience with optimized SQL-based data transformations for analytics and machine learning workloads
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks including notebooks, jobs, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow (nice to have)
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD practices with Git, Jenkins/Gitlab Actions
  • Strong AWS skills: S3, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, and related services
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, data governance, and security best practices
  • Experience with Airflow integration with AWS services for end-to-end orchestration across cloud data pipelines
  • Experience with IaC tools: Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Experience with Python is a Plus
  • Experience with DBT is a Plus
  • Experience with Snowflake is a Plus

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High degree of ownership and a mindset for continuous improvement
  • Quality oriented, pragmatic and solution oriented
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Experience in telecom sector is a plus
  • Experience with an agile way of working is a plus
  • English proficiency

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Job Description

Configuration manager - ServiceNow

Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented ServiceNow Configuration Manager to take ownership of our Configuration Management process and ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of our ServiceNow CMDB. In this key role, you will help strengthen the foundation of our ITSM processes by maintaining auditable configuration data that drives stable operations and informed decision‑making across the organization.

Joining Tieto Indtech, Nexus unit as a ServiceNow Configuration manager

As a Configuration Manager, you will be responsible for leading the governance, data quality, and ongoing development of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will collaborate closely with Process Owners, Product Management, Customer Service functions, and the ServiceNow Platform Owner to ensure that configuration data remains trustworthy, complete, and aligned with our platform strategy and ITSM practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about structure, accuracy, and continuous improvement — and who enjoys influencing how the organization manages technology information at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Configuration Management process and ensure the health and quality of CMDB data.
  • Define, develop, and maintain CMDB governance policies, including CI class models, naming conventions, and lifecycle states.
  • Maintain and enhance the CMDB data model, structure, and CI relationships.
  • Ensure configuration data is accurate, complete, compliant, and supports ITSM processes.
  • Collaborate with Incident, Change, Problem, and other Process Owners to ensure correct usage of CI data.
  • Support stakeholders across the organization in product management and customer onboarding activities.

Purpose

  • The Payroll and Benefits Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the payroll and benefits administration processes in a particular location to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant delivery of employee remuneration and associated benefits. This role requires a strong understanding of payroll regulations, benefits management, and employee satisfaction strategies while fostering alignment with global and local HR policies.

Responsibilities

  • You oversee the endtoend payroll process, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local labor laws, tax regulations, and SBM Offshore policies. You regularly monitor payroll outputs, promptly resolving any discrepancies or issues that arise. You ensure the timely submission of tax filings, social security contributions, and other statutory payments. Additionally, you collaborate with HR, Finance, and external vendors to maintain smooth and efficient payroll operations.
  • You manage various benefits programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, leave policies, and wellness initiatives. You review and suggest updates to benefits offerings to ensure they align with market trends and meet employee needs. You partner with benefits providers to maintain high service levels and cost efficiency, and you effectively communicate benefitsrelated information to employees.
  • You mentor and guide the Payroll and Benefits team, supporting their professional growth and development. You allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and address any skill gaps through training and support. You foster a collaborative work environment that aligns with SBM Offshore’s values and goals.
  • You ensure that payroll and benefits processes comply with local and global regulations, internal policies, and audits. You keep current on labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits trends to minimize risks. You support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and reports as needed.
  • You continuously identify opportunities to streamline payroll and benefits processes using technology and best practices. You develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and reports for HR and management review. Additionally, you contribute to HR strategic initiatives by providing valuable insights based on payroll and benefits data.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field. Payroll or benefitsspecific certifications are advantageous.

Experience

  • Experience in payroll and benefits management, preferably within the oil and gas or offshore industries.
  • Expertise in relevant social security reporting and regulations, ensuring accurate submissions and updates as required by law.
  • Handson experience with payroll systems tailored to local labor laws.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management skills.
  • Experience working with HRIS and payroll systems (e.g., SAP, Workday).
  • Strong knowledge of local labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with excellent problemsolving skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and payroll software.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in English and relevant local language.

Functional Competencies

Tools and data governance Diversity and inclusion Organization change and development Learning and development People engagement Payroll Labour law Change Management Personnel administration

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean Policy

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

RESPONSIBILITIES

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
Responsabilidades

  • Supervisiona e planeja a demanda diária de acordo com o cronograma de entregas estabelecido.
